governingTerms.section: 4. License to your Content (For Users in the Free Plan)
governingTerms.operativeRestriction: Free-plan User Output is licensed solely for personal, non-commercial and internal evaluation purposes; it may not be sold, sublicensed, redistributed, monetized, or used in connection with commercial activities, advertising, client work, revenue-generating products or services.

voiceSupplementalTerms.finding: Voice Terms do not expand Free Plan output rights; rights and commercial-use restrictions remain governed by the applicable plan and agreement.

publicHelpCenterConflict.articleSummary: The Help Center article broadly says HeyGen videos may be distributed commercially.
publicHelpCenterConflict.limitation: The article's general statement does not override the express Free Plan restrictions in the Terms or grant voice-specific commercial permission.
publicHelpCenterConflict.supportClarification: HeyGen Support stated the Free-plan limitations apply and the account plan Terms and Conditions take precedence; Support cannot issue a legally binding licensing determination.

legalRequestScope: Existing Roderic narration generated on the Free plan
Future narration generated with the same public voice

evidenceNote: HeyGen Support's written denial supersedes the earlier pending-exception state. The existing 398.083-second Roderic WAV and future Free-plan Roderic outputs are internal-only and cannot be used in public branded or commercial production. No paid upgrade is authorized and no other narrator may be substituted without explicit owner approval.

providerDenial.summary: HeyGen Support explicitly denied a zero-cost commercial-use exception for existing and future Roderic Free-plan outputs. Free-plan output remains restricted to personal, non-commercial and internal evaluation.
